name: Privacy
description: Stop sites from following you around.

addons.name: Multi-Account Containers
addons.description: Keeps sites in separate containers, each with its own cookies and logins.

addons.name: Facebook Container
addons.description: Keeps Facebook in its own container so it cannot follow you to other sites.

addons.name: Privacy Badger
addons.description: Learns which trackers follow you across sites and blocks them.

addons.name: LocalCDN
addons.description: Serves common web libraries from your machine instead of third-party servers.

name: Password managers
description: Fill logins from the password manager you use.

addons.name: Passbolt
addons.description: Fills logins from a Passbolt server.

addons.name: Bitwarden
addons.description: Fills logins from Bitwarden or Vaultwarden.

addons.name: KeePassXC-Browser
addons.description: Fills logins from the KeePassXC app on this machine.

addons.name: Nextcloud Passwords
addons.description: Fills logins from the Passwords app on your Nextcloud.

name: Comfort
description: Make the web easier on the eyes and hands.

addons.name: Vimium
addons.description: Browse with the keyboard, using vim keys.

addons.name: SponsorBlock
addons.description: Skips sponsor segments in YouTube videos.

addons.name: Consent-O-Matic
addons.description: Answers cookie pop-ups with the fewest permissions.
